# IAdmiralsQuartersWhitelist
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IAdmiralsQuartersWhitelist.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IAdmiralsQuartersEvents](../events/i-admirals-quarters-events.md), [IAdmiralsQuartersErrors](../errors/i-admirals-quarters-errors.md)

**Title:**
IAdmiralsQuartersWhitelist

Interface for the AdmiralsQuartersWhitelist contract, which manages interactions with FleetCommanders and
token swaps

only whitelisted accounts can use the contract


## Functions
### depositTokens

Deposits tokens into the contract

Emits a TokensDeposited event


```solidity
function depositTokens(IERC20 asset, uint256 amount) external payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`asset`|`IERC20`|The token to be deposited|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to deposit|


### withdrawTokens

Withdraws tokens from the contract

Emits a TokensWithdrawn event


```solidity
function withdrawTokens(IERC20 asset, uint256 amount) external payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`asset`|`IERC20`|The token to be withdrawn|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to withdraw (0 for all)|


### enterFleet

Enters a FleetCommander by depositing tokens

Emits a FleetEntered event


```solidity
function enterFleet(
    address fleetCommander,
    uint256 assets,
    address receiver
)
    external
    payable
    returns (uint256 shares);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetCommander`|`address`|The address of the FleetCommander contract|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of the FleetCommander's underlying asset to deposit (0 means use the contract's full balance of the underlying)|
|`receiver`|`address`|The address to receive the shares|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The number of shares received from the FleetCommander|


### enterFleetWithPermit2

Enters a FleetCommander by depositing tokens using Permit2 witness transfers

Emits a FleetEntered event


```solidity
function enterFleetWithPermit2(
    address owner,
    address fleetCommander,
    uint256 assets,
    bytes calldata _referralCode,
    address receiver,
    ISignatureTransfer.PermitTransferFrom calldata permitData,
    bytes calldata signature
)
    external
    payable
    returns (uint256 shares);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|The address of the token owner|
|`fleetCommander`|`address`|The address of the FleetCommander contract|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The exact amount of the FleetCommander's underlying to deposit; must equal `permitData.permitted.amount` (passing `0` is not supported unless the signature itself was issued for `0`)|
|`_referralCode`|`bytes`|Reserved for ABI parity with the public (non-whitelist) variant. This implementation ignores the value on-chain and substitutes `bytes32(0)` into the witness payload. SDKs and frontends MUST sign with a zero-value referral for signature compatibility.|
|`receiver`|`address`|The address to receive the shares|
|`permitData`|`ISignatureTransfer.PermitTransferFrom`|The permit2 data|
|`signature`|`bytes`|The signature for permit2|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The number of shares received from the FleetCommander|


### exitFleet

Exits a FleetCommander by withdrawing the underlying asset

Emits a FleetExited event


```solidity
function exitFleet(address fleetCommander, uint256 assets) external payable returns (uint256 shares);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fleetCommander`|`address`|The address of the FleetCommander contract|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of the FleetCommander's underlying asset to withdraw (0 withdraws the caller's full share balance)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The number of FleetCommander shares burnt to satisfy the withdrawal|


### swap

Performs a token swap using 1inch Router

Emits a Swapped event


```solidity
function swap(
    IERC20 fromToken,
    IERC20 toToken,
    uint256 assets,
    uint256 minTokensReceived,
    bytes calldata swapCalldata
)
    external
    payable
    returns (uint256 swappedAmount);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fromToken`|`IERC20`|The token to swap from|
|`toToken`|`IERC20`|The token to swap to|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of fromToken to swap|
|`minTokensReceived`|`uint256`|The minimum amount of toToken to receive after the swap|
|`swapCalldata`|`bytes`|The calldata for the 1inch swap|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`swappedAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of toToken received after the swap|


### rescueTokens

Allows the owner to rescue ERC20 tokens or native ETH sent to the contract by mistake

When `token` equals `NATIVE_PSEUDO_ADDRESS`, the contract forwards native ETH (using
the contract's full ETH balance when `amount == 0`); otherwise it forwards `amount` of
the ERC20.

Can only be called by the contract owner

Emits a TokensRescued event


```solidity
function rescueTokens(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`IERC20`|The address of the ERC20 token to rescue, or `NATIVE_PSEUDO_ADDRESS` for ETH|
|`to`|`address`|The address to send the rescued tokens to|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to rescue (ignored for native ETH when `0`, which sends the full balance)|


### moveFromERC4626ToAdmiralsQuarters

Imports a position from an ERC4626 vault to AdmiralsQuarters, has to be followed by a call to enter fleet

If zero shares are provided, the full balance of the vault is imported

needs approval from the user to withdraw on their behalf (e.g.
ERC4626Vault.approve(address(admiralsQuarters), type(uint256).max))

Emits an ERC4626PositionImported event


```solidity
function moveFromERC4626ToAdmiralsQuarters(address vault, uint256 shares) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vault`|`address`|The address of the ERC4626 vault|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The amount of vault tokens to import|


### moveFromAaveToAdmiralsQuarters

Imports a position from an Aave aToken to AdmiralsQuarters, has to be followed by a call to enter fleet

If zero amount is provided, the full balance of the aToken is imported

needs approval from the user to transfer from their wallet (e.g. aUSDC.approve(address(admiralsQuarters),
type(uint256).max))

approval requires small buffer due to constant accrual of interest

Emits an AavePositionImported event


```solidity
function moveFromAaveToAdmiralsQuarters(address aToken, uint256 assets) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`aToken`|`address`|The address of the Aave aToken|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of aToken to import|


### moveFromCompoundToAdmiralsQuarters

Imports a position from a Compound cToken to AdmiralsQuarters, has to be followed by a call to enter
fleet

If zero amount is provided, the full balance of the cToken is imported

needs approval from the user to withdraw on their behalf (e.g. cUSDC.allow(address(admiralsQuarters),true))

Emits a CompoundPositionImported event


```solidity
function moveFromCompoundToAdmiralsQuarters(address cToken, uint256 assets) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`cToken`|`address`|The address of the Compound cToken|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of cToken balance to import|


### claimMerkleRewards

Claims merkle rewards for a user


```solidity
function claimMerkleRewards(
    address user,
    uint256[] calldata indices,
    uint256[] calldata amounts,
    bytes32[][] calldata proofs,
    address rewardsRedeemer
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|Address to claim rewards for|
|`indices`|`uint256[]`|Array of merkle proof indices|
|`amounts`|`uint256[]`|Array of merkle proof amounts|
|`proofs`|`bytes32[][]`|Array of merkle proof data|
|`rewardsRedeemer`|`address`|Address of the rewards redeemer contract|
